deadline.value: December 15 for full consideration (year inferred); primarily fall entry
deadline.quote: Applications should be submitted by December 15th for full consideration. We admit primarily students who start in the fall.

app_fee.quote: There is a $75 application fee for each application.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School waivers for need/financial hardship (bank or mobile-money statement accepted), veterans, national-fellowship applicants, or at department discretion; no citizenship limit stated. Physics also offers a limited number of departmental waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants to Graduate School-administered degree programs [1] are eligible for an application fee waiver. | on the basis of need or financial hardship | Bank statement/mobile money statement

also.quote: The Department of Physics and Astronomy provides a limited number of application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: General GRE not required or accepted (page wording refers to "applications in 2025")
gre_general.quote: The Subject and General GRE scores are not required or accepted for applications in 2025.

gre_physics.value: Physics subject GRE not required or accepted (page wording refers to "applications in 2025")
gre_physics.quote: The Subject and General GRE scores are not required or accepted for applications in 2025.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 overall with Speaking 23 (old scale) or 4.5 average, no section below 4.0 (new scale); IELTS 7.0; Duolingo 120; programs may require more
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT pre-February 2026 scoring system | 80 minimum overall score | Minimum of 23 on the Speaking section

english_waiver.value: Waived for anyone with a bachelor's (or higher) degree, or at least two years of post-secondary study, at an English-medium institution
english_waiver.quote: The English proficiency exam is waived for | students who have earned a degree (bachelor’s or higher) or completed at least two years of post-secondary education at an institution where the medium of instruction is English.

supervisor.value: Students are not admitted to a specific advisor, though funded advisors' recommendations weigh strongly; must state experiment vs theory preference
supervisor.quote: Students are not admitted to work with a specific research advisor. However, the recommendations of funded research advisors are considered strongly by the admissions committee.

funding.value: All admitted students receive full tuition support and a stipend (TA first, RA later)
funding.quote: All admitted students receive full tuition support and a stipend.

entry_route.value: Graduate School requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent and GPA 3.0
entry_route.quote: These requirements include a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent, as well as an undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or greater on a 4.0 scale.

notes: Selected applicants get an online interview. Admission decision cannot be made until TOEFL/IELTS scores arrive. Strong applicants automatically considered for internal fellowships.
